summary: The community primarily revolves around prominent Formula One drivers Lewis Hamilton, Nico Rosberg, and Valtteri Bottas, all of whom have driven for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. Hamilton and Rosberg were teammates from 2013 to 2016, during which Rosberg won the World Drivers' Championship in 2016. Bottas joined Mercedes in 2017 and remained until 2021, later returning as a reserve driver in 2024 and 2025. The community also highlights the competitive dynamics among these drivers, including their achievements and race results.

key_statements.statement: Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg were teammates at Mercedes from 2013 to 2016, during which Rosberg won the World Drivers' Championship in 2016.
Valtteri Bottas drove for Mercedes from 2017 to 2021 and later rejoined as a reserve driver in 2024 and 2025.
